source_review: physical-target memory is separate from unchanged per-visit/native authorization fences
persistent scope excludes controller incarnation but resets on seed/restart/stage/stage_type/dimension
observed-door graph only; native visited preserved; paid/special doors cannot be intermediate implicit steps
shared fallback checks current door geometry, lock, type, budget and reachability
refusal/failure objectives removed from distant room attractions; relevant new conditions reopen DSH offers only
goal continuity is bounded by actual progress and edge count; ordinary pauses and repeated goals do not clear memory
original DSH model/channel, voice/mouth/GPU/official-capture/save constraints retained; protected user CSV excluded
observed engine loading grace is capped at ten seconds, never makes stale state fresh, never grants input or suppresses explicit pause
native 500ms fresh-observation handoff is one-shot per identity/unhold and does not renew any input lease or clear normal pause latch
every fact and decision attempt obtains a fresh random DSH request identity independent of replayable event identity and resettable attempt counters
event/playback deduplication, current turn fences, cancellation and actual failure disarm retained; no model substitution or automatic retry
finite local session conflict code and create/model phase diagnostics contain no raw error message, credentials or voice inputs
local diagnostics retain finite setup stage, whitelisted exception/errno/guard, package-relative stack positions and a message digest only; no raw error or absolute source paths
diagnostics do not retry, alter DSH strategic ownership, bypass failure pause or claim the unknown real session-create failure fixed
core catch retains finite original diagnostic even for setup-before-try and post-return dispose errors; dispose cleanup always removes active handle; raw errors and permissions unchanged

valid wait/active choices have no movement action ID; explicit null preserves strict history and audit JSON without fabricating an action; fact state reads and pre-reservation failures also use null optional identity fields

defects: NAV05 real accepted wait receipt has absent offer action_id; exact source replay proves native success followed by NON_JSON_UNDEFINED in core_choice_completed serialization
closed_test_round.current_round_scope: explicit null for optional native audit fields; retain strict serializer and real failure disarm
